disclosure.title: PROJECT PROTOCOLS
disclosure.subtitle: ENGAGEMENT RULES & LEGAL FRAMEWORK
disclosure.rule_1_desc: Any modifications to the technical brief after project start will require a re-evaluation of the blueprint and budget.
disclosure.rule_2_desc: Progress reviews will be conducted exclusively via live Demos on the selected sync channel.
disclosure.rule_3_desc: The client will provide necessary access keys (API Keys, Hosting, DB) for frictionless execution.
disclosure.rule_4_desc: Each milestone includes up to [2] rounds of revisions. Structural or functional changes outside the blueprint are new missions.
disclosure.rule_5_desc: Subscriptions to APIs, hosting, domains, or external services are the sole financial responsibility of the client.
disclosure.rule_6_desc: The developer is not responsible for system administration or maintenance post-delivery without a support contract.
disclosure.rule_7_desc: The client must respond to critical requests in <48h. Prolonged silence will pause the mission automatically.
disclosure.rule_8_desc: Silence exceeding [15] days will result in project archiving. Reactivation applies a 15% re-onboarding fee.
disclosure.rule_9_desc: Rights transfer upon final payment. The developer retains a perpetual right to display the project in their professional portfolio.
disclosure.rule_10_desc: Maximum liability is capped at the paid value of the project. No liability for lost profits or indirect damages.
disclosure.rule_11_desc: The client guarantees provided material does not violate third-party copyrights and assumes full legal responsibility.
disclosure.rule_12_desc: The relationship is that of an independent contractor. No employment, agency, or partnership exists.
disclosure.rule_13_desc: No liability for delays caused by global infrastructure failures (SaaS, Vercel, Supabase, OpenAI).
disclosure.rule_14_desc: Any legal dispute or mediation will be resolved under the laws and courts of the developer's residence.
disclosure.rule_15_desc: Ideas, designs, or code presented during the blueprint phase but not selected remain the property of the developer.
disclosure.rule_16_desc: If the client requests accelerated delivery sacrificing architecture, the developer is exonerated from future optimizations.
disclosure.rule_17_desc: Standard measures are implemented; no responsibility for breaches caused by unknown third-party vulnerabilities.
disclosure.rule_18_desc: The client confirms the project is for professional purposes and does not violate university academic integrity policies.
disclosure.rule_19_desc: The developer communicates their specialization status and the client accepts the work based on the visual portfolio.
disclosure.rule_20_desc: The developer may cancel the project in cases of harassment or abuse, charging for proportional progress made.
